# @canopy/matcher

BSON comparison order, in-process filter matching, sort, projection and update operators, verified against MongoDB.

The client runs queries and updates locally with it, and the realtime server routes change events with it. A differential test suite keeps it equal to MongoDB.

Part of [Canopy](https://github.com/FlazexHQ/Canopy), an open source, self hostable backend platform for MongoDB. Nothing is
published to npm yet: until then, use it from a clone of the repository.

## Install

```bash
bun add @canopy/matcher
```

`pnpm add`, `yarn add` and `npm install` take the same names.

## Use

```ts
import { applyUpdate, compareValues, compileFilter } from "@canopy/matcher"

const open = compileFilter({ status: "open", total: { $gte: 100 } })
open.matches({ status: "open", total: 120 }) // true
const updated = applyUpdate({ _id: 1, tags: ["a"] }, { $push: { tags: "b" }, $inc: { views: 1 } })
compareValues(null, 0) // below zero: null sorts before numbers, as in MongoDB
```
